journal_lines: Red dust in the deepslate. Redstone.
Deep vein, crackling faintly. Took the lot.
Redstone runs in veins down here. Found a good one.
The deep rock glows red when you chip it.
The deepslate face crackled when the pickaxe touched it.
Red powder spilling from the vein. Careful not to waste it.
Two redstone veins on the same wall face.
The glow was faint but real. Followed it.
Dense deposit, uniform coloring. Good extraction.
The whole lower section of this wall was red-bearing stone.
Found it below the lava shelf. Required care.
Crackling faintly in the silence. The sound led here.
Redstone mixed with deepslate makes both harder to work. Did it anyway.
The vein ran to eight. Took every piece.
Found the main body by following the spatter trail.
The glow in the dark was the first clue. The second clue was the smell.
